description: Exact idempotent-count cycle law, all-moment generating function, arithmetic second-moment growth and logarithmic typical-count concentration for uniform invertible weighted-permutation evolution algebras over finite fields.
scientific_integrity: Cycle decomposition from earlier literature and standard permutation/finite-field counting are acknowledged. New quantitative statements are distinguished. A standalone direct finite-field verifier is provided; exhaustive cases cannot establish general asymptotics. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled monomial structure-matrix ensemble only; all idempotent elements include zero; fixed finite field in asymptotics. No claim for uniformly sampled isomorphism classes or arbitrary invertible structure matrices. Root-of-unity analytic transfer is standard, with fixed-field constants; no convergence rate or central-limit theorem. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Arithmetic idempotent moments and a mean–typical gap in random monomial evolution algebras
